title: 众人低配：美债短期反弹，但能持续多久？
speaker: Tracy Chen

segments.en: Yeah, I think if you look at the positioning, the CDA positioning, people are underweight duration right now.
segments.zh: 如果你看仓位，目前人们普遍低配久期。

segments.en: So it doesn't take a lot for people to cover their underweight. So I think in a near-term treasury can have a bit of a rally.
segments.zh: 所以回补低配并不需要太多推动，短期内美债可能有所反弹。

segments.en: But I don't think that will last long. So, hence, I think the auction should go well, because of the simple fact that people are so underweight.
segments.zh: 但我认为反弹不会持续太久。因此拍卖应该会顺利，因为人们仓位太轻。

segments.en: And I think they were priced less, a probability of hike. So you can see two-year can rally more than 30-year.
segments.zh: 而且市场对加息概率的定价较低，所以两年期收益率可能比30年期反弹更多。

segments.en: You will see a curve steepening in a near-term, either bare-steepening or a boost-steepening. But there should be some kind of a steepening to gradually price out of the September hike.
segments.zh: 短期内你会看到曲线陡峭化，无论是熊陡还是牛陡。但总会有某种陡峭化来逐步消化9月加息预期。
